title: Sam’s Prairie Adventure
moral: Be brave, be smart, and never give up.

scenes.summary: Sam rides his horse Dusty across the prairie with a mission.
scenes.text: Sam rides his horse Dusty across the bright prairie carrying marbles for children in the next town.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy riding horse across golden prairie with blue sky, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: The sun was bright over the wide golden prairie. Sam the cowboy rode his brown horse Dusty. Sam wore a big hat red scarf and shiny boots. He liked to sing as he rode. He was going to the next town to bring a bag of shiny marbles for the children. Sam and Dusty rode along the dusty path. They saw cacti flowers and prairie dogs. After a while Sam saw a deep rocky cliff. The path looked broken and unsafe. Sam stopped and remembered to be brave and smart. He searched for another way. He found a hidden path through tall grass. He carefully led Dusty along the narrow path. A rock blocked the way so Sam pushed it away with effort. They continued slowly and safely. Soon they reached the safe path again. Sam and Dusty arrived in town where children welcomed them happily. Sam gave each child a marble. The children laughed and played. Sam felt proud for being brave and not giving up. As the sun set Sam and Dusty rested happily under the sky.
